getter=ctypes.CDLL(None)._dyld_get_shared_cache_uuid

if not getter(buffer):raise ValueError('active cache UUID unavailable')

with main.open('rb') as stream:header=stream.read(104)

if active!='d64a142b-8533-3e09-968a-6ad3e176e3f6' or active!=cache:raise ValueError('active cache UUID mismatch')
family=[str(path) for path in sorted(root.iterdir()) if path.is_file() and (path.name==main.name or path.name.startswith(main.name+'.'))]
print(json.dumps({'active_cache_uuid':active,'cache_header_uuid':cache,'cache_magic':header[:16].decode('ascii'),'family':family},sort_keys=True))

import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/System/Volumes/Preboot/Cryptexes/OS/System/Library/dyld');main='dyld_shared_cache_arm64e';rows=[]
for path in sorted(root.iterdir()):
 if not path.is_file() or not (path.name==main or path.name.startswith(main+'.')):continue
 digest=hashlib.sha256()
 with path.open('rb') as stream:
  for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(8*1024*1024),b''):digest.update(block)
 rows.append({'path':str(path),'bytes':path.stat().st_size,'sha256':digest.hexdigest()})
if not rows:raise ValueError('empty cache family')
print(json.dumps(rows,sort_keys=True))
